title: Comparatives & Superlatives: Business Review
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has repasado cómo comparar productos, servicios y rendimiento en un contexto empresarial.

stages.title: Repaso: Comparativos y Superlativos en Negocios

parts.visual: Comparativos (para 2 cosas): Añadimos -er a adjetivos cortos (cheaper) o 'more' a los largos (more expensive). Siempre usamos 'than'. Our product is cheaper than theirs (Nuestro producto es más barato que el de ellos).
parts.audio: Comparatives are for two things. We add -er to short adjectives like cheaper, or more to long ones like more expensive. We always use than. Our product is cheaper than theirs.

parts.visual: Superlativos (para 3+ cosas): Añadimos -est a los cortos (the cheapest) o 'the most' a los largos (the most expensive). This is the best option (Esta es la mejor opción). Irregulares: good -> better -> the best. bad -> worse -> the worst.
parts.audio: Superlatives are for three or more things. We add -est to short adjectives like the cheapest, or the most to long ones like the most expensive. Irregulars: good, better, the best. Bad, worse, the worst.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta para comparar en el entorno corporativo.

questions.question: Our software is ____ than theirs. (Más rápido).
This is the ____ option we have. (La mejor).
The new model is ____ expensive than the old one. (Más caro).
Who is the ____ reliable supplier? (El más confiable).
Sales this month are ____ than last month. (Peores).
This is the ____ quarter of the year. (El peor).
Our prices are ____ than our competitors. (Más bajos).
This is the ____ important project. (El más importante).
Working from home is ____ comfortable than commuting. (Más cómodo).
She is the ____ efficient employee in the team. (La más eficiente).
The new office is ____ than the old one. (Más grande).
This is the ____ meeting room we have. (La más pequeña).
The meeting was ____ than I expected. (Más larga).
This solution is ____ than the previous one. (Mejor).
He is the ____ experienced manager. (El más experimentado).
The deadline is ____ than we thought. (Más cerca).
This is the ____ profitable product. (El más rentable).
The new design is ____ attractive than the old one. (Más atractivo).
Which option is ____? (¿Cuál opción es más segura? - Safe).
This is the ____ company in the market. (La más grande).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la forma correcta del comparativo o superlativo.

questions.question: This option is ____. (Mejor - good).
This is the ____ option. (La mejor - good).
Sales are ____ this month. (Peores - bad).
This is the ____ quarter. (El peor - bad).
Our software is ____. (Más rápido - fast).
It is ____ expensive than before. (Más).
It is the ____ important project. (El más).
Prices are ____ than theirs. (Más bajos - low).
This is the ____ company. (La más grande - big).
The meeting was ____ than expected. (Más larga - long).

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Our software is faster than theirs.
options: Our software is faster than theirs.
Our system is faster than theirs.
Our software is better than theirs.
Our software is faster than ours.
questions.correct_answer: Our software is faster than theirs.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: This is the best option we have.

This is the better option we have.
This is the best option they have.
